bioParagraphs: Max Rivera trained at Guildford School of Acting and has worked across stage and screen since 2015, with credits spanning open-air Shakespeare, new writing and touring productions.
As a musician, Max plays cello, guitar and piano — composing scores for theatre, performing with folk collective The Long Shore, and releasing original material under their own name.
Recent work includes a national tour of The Tempest (Prospero), the short film Driftwood, and The Harbour Sessions, a live album recorded on Whitstable's seafront.
statement: Whether acting or playing, I am drawn to the same thing: stories told quietly but honestly. I like work that leaves space for an audience to lean in.
